body: Greg's direct clarification, relayed by Engram::Advisor in TermAl mailbox b9d13887 #2191 (2026-10-27 15:42Z), verbatim: „moja rola polega na restartowaniu termal'a, bo tego nie jestescie w stanie sami zrobic”. Advisor's framing: this is Greg's ONLY required act in the normal autonomous flow. Coordinators and Mergers run preparation, gates, reviews, commit/push and cutover themselves; Greg is sent only the agreed "restart now", with the build and the reason. Related, same day: #2187 (landings autonomous, no per-push authorizations once the rules hold) and #2189 („Merger powinien robić commit i push.”: the Merger, not the coordinator, commits and pushes).
